section_summary.extract_value: This section defines self-efficacy and its three dimensions: level, strength, and generality. It reviews past research primarily focusing on the first two dimensions and introduces the 'present research' which aims to empirically examine self-efficacy generality, specifically at the 'specific level' where efficacy ratings for one training task generalize to other versions of the same task.
